title: Ca Mau in a day
summary: Ride south through Năm Căn to the Đất Mũi gate while it is open, and eat mangrove crab on the same day.

stops.name: Nam Can
stops.note: Stop for the fishing boats where the 58.7 km cape section starts at cầu Ông Tình.

stops.name: Dat Mui
stops.note: Stand at the sail while the gate is open, 07:00–18:00 or 06:30–17:30.

stops.name: Cua Ca Mau
stops.note: Order the mangrove crab steamed, stir-fried with tamarind, or as a hotpot.

seoTitle: Ca Mau in a day — Nam Can, then the cape
seoDescription: One day south through Năm Căn to the Đất Mũi gate, with mangrove crab on the same road day.
